description: 臺北捷運轉乘車站轉乘步行時間 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北大眾捷運股份有限公司. 提供臺北捷運所有轉乘車站之轉乘步行估計時間. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北大眾捷運股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
